At PALFINGER, we have been lifting goods to a new level for over 90 years - with a pioneering and passionate spirit. As a global technology and engineering company, we are the world's leading manufacturer and supplier of innovative crane and lifting solutions. Our success is based on the tireless efforts of our approximately 12,350 employees, who contribute their ideas and energy to our vision. With us, you can expect a dynamic working environment full of opportunities for personal and professional development. Become part of our team and start your career at PALFINGER.

You work in a structured, goal-oriented and independent manner? You bring your experience and interest in the development and optimization of logistics processes and thus take the opportunity to actively shape the future of the SAP S/4 HANA system together with the PALFINGER process and data organization. You can bring innovations and process changes to the S/4 HANA system via release cycles. If you find yourself here, then you are the right person as SAP Inhouse Consultant at PALFINGER. 1 Senior Expert SAP (f/m/d) MM/EWM YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Consult and support business processes with focus on SAP EWM, SAP MM (Purchasing), and SAP TM

 * Design, document, implement/customize, and optimize logistics processes in alignment with the Process & Data Organization

 * Participate in and contribute to specification workshops for new business requirements

 * Coordinate and collaborate with external implementation partners, acting as an interface between PALFINGER and external teams

 * Independently manage tasks such as leading work packages or (part) project leadership, including preparation and reporting of workshops and project meetings, as well as handling incidents in assigned modules

 

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

 * 5+ years of experience as an SAP Inhouse Consultant or Application Manager, ideally with focus on SAP logistics modules (EWM/MM/TM)

 * Completed HTL/UNI/FH/HAK or comparable professional experience

 * Strong understanding of logistics processes; willingness to learn new SAP modules; ABAP debugging knowledge is a plus

 * Analytical, structured, autonomous, and precise working style

 * Fluent in German and English both written and verbal; strong team orientation and solution focus

WHAT WE OFFER

 * Flexible working hours with no core time and possibility to work from home

 * Further training and international career opportunities

 * Corporate health management "PALfit"

 * Company restaurant with freshly prepared meals and daily meal subsidy

 * Job ticket for travel to and from PALFINGER

 * Numerous employee discounts through Corporate Benefits

 

Minimum yearly gross salary according to Austrian metal industry collective agreement is EUR 53.241,02. based on full-time employment. According to experience and qualification, we offer a market-conform overpayment.

1 Semiconductor Equipment Engineer (all genders) The SAL team is looking for a motivated and hands-on R&D Service Engineer to support our cleanroom team. At SAL MicroFab, we work in a modern R&D cleanroom environment with high-end semiconductor equipment, bridging science and industry through innovative research and technology development.

In this position, you will take ownership of technical tasks that are essential for keeping our cleanroom operations running reliably and efficiently. You will work closely with engineers, researchers, and external suppliers while continuously developing your technical skills in a highly innovative environment. Your contribution will directly support cutting-edge research and future technology development at SAL. 

Your future tasks include:

 * Supporting the continuous improvement of maintenance processes and equipment reliability within the cleanroom environment

 * Preparing and maintaining technical documentation, maintenance records, and operating procedures

 * Coordinating service activities with external vendors as well as internal stakeholders
 * Supporting organizational and administrative activities within the team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations 

Your profile:

 * A reliable and motivated team player who is also able to work independently and solve technical challenges proactively
 * Ability to read and understand technical drawings, schematics, and service manuals 
 * Good knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel); experience with AutoCAD or SolidWorks is a plus
 * Good communication skills in German and English
 * Comfortable working in an international and collaborative research environment where flexibility and teamwork are important 

Important Facts about SAL:
 * Diverse research activities with many technical challenges.
 * State-of-the-art laboratory facilities and equipment.
 * Location in the heart of Europe in Austria - relocation support for non-European nationalities.
